sections.section: ORDER - President's Order 12, Election Commission (Second Amendment) Order 1984

PRESIDENT'S ORDER 12 OF 1984
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 12 OF 1984
ELECTION
COMMISSION (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1984
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 2nd December, 1984]
No. F. 17(2)/84-Pub.-The
following Order made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
In pursuance of the Proclamation
of the fifth day of July, 1977, and in exercise of all powers enabling him in
that behalf, the President is pleased to make the following Order :-
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Order may be called the Election Commission (Second
Amendment) Order, 1984.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
2. Amendment of Article 2, P.
(P. P.) O. No. 4 of 1977.---In the Elec tion Commission Order, 1977 [P. (P.
P.) O. No. 4 of 1977], in Article 2, in clause (1), the word "forthcoming"
shall be omitted.
